finding: The inclusive scale-two graph-metric Rips complex of GP(n,2) collapses to C_n for every n>=13, with a rank-three mod-two H2 obstruction at n=12.
integrity: An explicit five-case symbolic graph-link collapse proves the unrestricted n>=13 statement. Independent graph-distance, domination, clique and mod-two boundary calculations corroborate its ingredients and certify the finite n=12 Betti table.
scientific_limitations: Only the inclusive scale-two graph metric for GP(n,2) at n>=13 and the mod-two exception at n=12 are determined; other graph parameters, scales, and integral torsion are outside scope. Earlier unindexed equivalent results remain a possibility.
title: A sharp twelve-to-thirteen Rips collapse transition in generalized Petersen graphs
